name: Facet
text: Default to system preference for theme, with a persistent manual override toggle. This keeps the interface adaptive and reduces friction for users who prefer their OS settings, while the toggle ensures accessibility for those who need high contrast or dislike dark themes. The trade-off is slightly more complex settings management, but it’s worth it for universal comfort and speed of use.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode if it’s the default, even when light mode would help them see better. A better alternative: start with system preference, but log the override choice and prompt users to reconsider after 30 days. Settle it with A/B testing: measure task completion time and error rates in both modes.
